error_chain.expected_solution: Cross-repo propagation chain: (1) Flask's globals.py defines `request` as a LocalProxy backed by werkzeug.local.Local with a contextvars-based storage strategy -> (2) Werkzeug's local.py replaced the threadlocal storage with contextvars.ContextVar so that async coroutines see a per-task logical context -> (3) Flask's ctx.py pushes a RequestContext onto the Local stack at the start of dispatching and pops it at request teardown -> (4) When the async view awaits asyncio.create_task(coro), the task captures the current context via copy_context, preserving the bound request proxy -> (5) When code instead schedules work onto a thread pool or uses a bare ensure_future without copying context, the spawned task evaluates ContextVar.get() in an empty context, raising RuntimeError from the LocalProxy access.
